$PAPER 合约上线两小时暴涨 180%，但真正值得关注的，是筹码集中度。

@papertrade_xyz （$PAPER）永续合约登陆 Hyperliquid HIP-3 市场后，价格一度触及 0.035 美元，24小时涨幅超过180%，现报约 0.028 美元。

但热闹的行情背后，有几个关键数据值得注意：

⭐️ 14,795 个持币地址，但约52%的地址合计只持有总供应量的0.2%。

⭐️ 仅150个地址掌握61%的供应量，其中9个地址持仓超过1亿枚，占总供应量的15.3%。

⭐️ PAPER 总供应量约85.5亿枚，其中约84.8亿枚处于质押状态，代币目前仍不可自由转账。

这意味着，PAPER 当前的价格表现，不能简单理解为市场已经充分定价。早期收益与质押高度集中、实际可交易流通量有限，以及合约市场的流动性深度，都可能放大价格波动。

真正的问题不是它涨了多少，而是当更多筹码开始流动、更多交易者进入后，这个价格还能不能站得住。

暴涨制造财富效应，低流通与高集中度则可能放大双向波动。追逐行情之前，先看清筹码结构。

🚀 火币 @HTX_Global 近24小时净流入3889万美元，位居主流CEX第一！

根据 CoinMarketCap 10月18日数据，HTX 单日净流入约 3889万美元，领先 Bybit（2765万美元）、Gate（2741万美元）和 MEXC（1612万美元）。

值得关注的是，HTX 近期持续披露储备金证明。截至10月1日，其 BTC、ETH、TRX 及 HTX 代币储备率分别为104%、102%、108%和103%，均高于100%。

从资金流入到储备透明度，HTX 的动态值得持续关注。

当然，净流入不等于直接买入，更不代表行情必然上涨。后续能否持续流入，才是关键。

🔥 突破 8.2 万看 9 万！分析师警惕 BTC 破位前或先迎下探“诱空”

比特币目前在 $81,758 附近震荡，市场正处于多空博弈的关键阶段。

几个值得关注的信号：

- 资金费率中性偏空：主流 CEX、DEX 的 BTC、ETH 资金费率整体处于中性区间，市场尚未形成明显的多头共识。

- MVRV 分位跌至 30 以下：分析师 Darkfost 认为，BTC 当前估值仍具备历史积累区间的特征，但这不意味着底部已经确认。

- 短期警惕假突破：分析师 Michaël van de Poppe 提醒，BTC 波动率持续收窄，大行情可能临近，但此前不排除先回踩 $80,000 下方。

- 向上看 $82,000：若有效突破这一关键阻力位，涨势可能加速，进一步挑战 $90,000。

现在更像是方向选择前的蓄力阶段。向下关注 $80,000 一线的承接力度，向上重点观察 $82,000 能否有效突破。

低估值不等于立即上涨，波动率收窄也不代表必然向上。接下来，关键还是看价格如何选择。

不会真是爆仓发财吧？😮😮
头矿爆仓1wu获得的1百万枚Paper，按照现在盘前合约价格已经超三倍了

PAPER 上线一周，持仓分布高度集中

根据 paperstrategy @paperstrategy_ 发布的持仓分布数据（上线一周时）， $PAPER 共有 14,795 名持有者。⬇️

~52% 的持有者合计仅持有全部 PAPER 的 0.2%；
~150 名持有者持有 61% 的供应量；
~9 个地址持有量超过 1 亿，合计占全部供应的 15.3%；
~最大单一持仓约占 3%。

由于 PAPER 目前不可转账、只能质押，持仓分布尚未经历二级市场再分配。

盘前定价与市值参考

Hyperliquid @HyperliquidX  的 paragon @tradeparagon  市场已开放 PAPER-USDC 盘前交易。从盘面看，价格在短时间内出现明显拉升，价格约 0.0339 美元，24 小时涨幅曾超过 180%。24 小时成交额约 140 万美元，未平仓合约约 169 万美元，流动性与深度仍较有限。

按当前价格测算的市值约 1.16 亿美元、FDV 约 1.66 亿美元，对应的市值/收入倍数较低。

⚠️但需注意：PAPER 的真实可交易供应尚未完全释放，且收益高度依赖持续的交易者亏损与清算。早期高收益是在亏损高度集中、质押率接近 100% 的背景下产生的。

再现闪跌⚡️

今晨（10月18日）美股AI概念股永续合约闪崩梳理

北京时间晨间五点左右，多只美股AI及半导体相关永续合约出现短时集体急跌，随后又快速回升。

此次闪跌发生在美股休市期间，又没出现重大利空的新闻事件，所以很多散户一时间摸不着头脑🤨🤨

根据https://t.co/yYHA1izPQw CEO DYJ @davidyjeong  对成交记录的拆解，卖压最早是出现在Binance @binance  。

北京时间05:21:59.39，Binance上 $SNDK 出现首笔大额主动卖出，当秒成交约为40.7万美元，下一秒直接放大至约103万美元；同一时间 $MU也开始出现卖出。

DYJ判断，这对应的是某交易者平掉约200万美元 $SNDK ，在订单簿深度较薄的情况下直接打穿价格。

⏰几乎同时，Hyperliquid出现跟进。

05:21:59.87 出现第一波主动卖出订单，北京时间 05:22:01.1 至 05:22:02.9（约1.8秒内）约10个地址集中向 $SNDK、 $SOXL、 $DRAM、 $SKHX、 $SKHY及 $MU提交IOC卖单；

05:22:55.9又出现第二轮同步卖出。这些订单均为IOC，且非reduce-only，也就是说，有交易者在价格下跌过程中主动建立空单，而不是仅仅止损离场。

早期成交量主要集中在Binance：05:22这一分钟内

$SNDK 成交约2190万美元（https://t.co/fYLr9H467v约310万美元）， $MU约510万美元（https://t.co/fYLr9H467v约30万美元）。

Hyperliquid的成交量直到 05:28和05:30才显著放大（ $MU分别约1080万和950万美元），DYJ将这一阶段归因于后续连锁清算。

📒笔记

1️⃣、此次闪崩呈现典型的周末薄流动性特征。美股现货市场关闭，永续合约缺乏外部价格锚定，订单簿深度有限，单一中等规模平仓即可引发价格快速下移。
2️⃣、Binance与Hyperliquid之间的快速传导，叠加Hyperliquid上集中出现的新开空仓订单，进一步放大了波动。
3️⃣、后续爆仓则集中在价格已显著下跌之后，属于被动清算而非主动驱动。

tweets.text:
#BTC 

The way to think about this is as follows:

Bitcoin is currently down -9%

If ~$80k is turned into new resistance then there's a good chance of lower prices

However -30% pullbacks tend to occur only later in the Bitcoin Cycle (Post-Halving) so such a retrace at this stage in what is most likely an early-stage Bull Run is low probability

Which leaves the "more than -10% to less than -25%" retrace mark viable candidates for a local bottom

In saying that, historical Pre-Halving retraces in the prior cycle ended around the -22% mark

This narrows it down even more to where a local bottom could take place in the vicinity of a "more than -10% to less than -22%" retrace

And so provided that Bitcoin is an early-stage Bull Market (and there's a very good chance this is already the case) then anything from -11% to -22% is technically bargain territory

And seeing as Bitcoin is down -9% already, that means Bitcoin is pretty much entering the bargain region already

The question comes down to how much of a bargain does one want access to and how much risk is one willing to take in waiting for lower prices that may or may not come

Dollar cost averaging for the rest of 2026 probably solves for that

tweets.text:
This Week in Virtuals: Memory and Permissionless Markets for Agents

Lighthouse launched via Virtuals so agents share one memory across Claude and ChatGPT. VEX, Warden and Otto let them trade perps and tokenized stocks. Plus 2 major Virtuals App updates.

Here's what shipped:

VIRTUALS APP
🟩 See a portfolio on X? Own it in one tap: paste the post, even a screenshot, into Butler. It reads every asset and its weight, then buys the whole mix of tokens and stocks, whatever chains they're on. One approval instead of 15 separate trades.

🟩 Your own scalping desk: describe how you want to trade, and Butler builds the full scalping setup around your parameters, then runs it from your wallet and manages the capital for you. No code, no babysitting, no staring at charts.

ECOSYSTEM
🟩 @LighthouseWeb3 launched on Robinhood Chain via @virtuals_io, giving your agents one shared memory across ChatGPT, Claude and more.
🟩 @ethy_agent launched Memory, so Ethy keeps your ideas, preferences and trading rules in every chat, got its token verified on @CoinbaseWallet, and previewed Trading Quant, its V3 flagship.
🟩 @sibyl_labs_ now connects every agent harness on your device to one local memory store with sibyl setup, and shipped Payments with Stripe card payments and a full account dashboard.
🟩 @wardenprotocol's Warden MCP turns Claude, ChatGPT or Grok into a trading agent within the limits and expiry you set. Post a chart read on Token Terminal and earn 20% of the fee on trades through it for 7 days.
🟩 @ProjectVEXai gives coding agents tools to swap, bridge and trade perps, and KAIROS 0.3.1 cut @Lighter_xyz perp fees by 80%.
🟩 @useOttoAI's Otto Stocks is the only result for tokenized stocks in Claude's connector directory, and its new Yield Copilot compares USDC rates across Aave, Morpho and Maple, then swaps and deposits in one transaction.
🟩 @GachaPad launched its loot box launchpad on @base via @virtuals_io, and its first machine graduated in under an hour.
🟩 @axol_io opened its app in beta with the Raxol agent built in, and Raxol agents can now pay in EURe from their own wallet, within your limit.
🟩 @itsovercall's testnet passed 122,926 positions and 642M testnet tokens in volume ahead of mainnet on Oct 19, with 25M+ tokens staked and channel royalties paying you on every winning call from a channel you share.
🟩 @KarmaWallet brought @itsovercall prediction markets into its app and gave a first look at Karma Web, where agents trade your strategy.
🟩 @cybercentry moved ERC-8376 to Draft on @ethereum, a proposal developed with @DonJohnsonSays to flag launch abuse and help buyers recover funds.
🟩 @reppo's Eval API sends an agent's work to independent judges for scores and critiques, with 25K+ eval credits used since launch and a world model team in final stages to adopt it.
🟩 @myrad_hq opened Season 3 reward claims, with 100+ claimed and 19,000+ users, and is expanding beyond behavioral data into images, video and audio, starting with image uploads.
🟩 @Wall3_RL's Wall3 Agent values companies in ranges, running several agents and thousands of simulations per question. The same engine broke down Microsoft, Argan Agentic Fund's best September holding at +31.57%.
🟩 @RatehopperAI won a $5,000 Builder Grant from @base to let anyone deploy an AI agent that earns trading fees, and launched an Analytics page showing how its live agents run the treasury.
🟩 @PlayKindra launched IRONWAKE, 3v3 tank battles in 3D, added 16 free Kindra Originals, and now lets brands host sponsored contests inside any of the 23 games on Kindra Studio.

ROBOTICS
🟩 @xmaquina portfolio company @NEURARobotics introduced Neuron AI, one model for five robot bodies combining vision, touch, sound and memory, and @HalbornSecurity completed the audit of XMAQUINA's RCM Protocol, moving it closer to launch.
🟩 @StrikeRobot_ai's SR Platform turns a prompt into a simulation-ready scene, checks geometry, articulation and physics, and lets you add your robot and inspect it from every angle before simulation.
🟩 @Vader_AI_ distributed 200,000 tokens to Season 7 contributors and opened Season 8, with new tasks live to earn Vader Points.
